item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Eight security flaws in NodeBB went public on Wednesday, along with the code to exploit them. Aikido Security rates all eight as high severity and says its AI pentest agents found them in a six-hour review of the forum software's source code. Every version before 4.14.0 is affected. item.title: 🟠 Kimi K3 Agents Found Redis Zero-Days and Built RCE Exploit, Researchers Say
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Redis shipped seven security releases on July 23 after researchers published authenticated RCE PoCs for stock Redis 6.2.22, 7.4.9, 8.6.4, and 8.8.0. All four chains require RESTORE. The Streams chains also need EVAL and XGROUP; the 8.8.0 chain needs EVAL and the bundled RedisBloom module. Redis says the underlying memory flaws may lead to remote code execution.
